newsitem.title: UK: Budgens says sales up in current trading.
newsitem.headline: Budgens says sales up in current trading.

text.p: Supermarkets group Budgens Plc said total sales, excluding lottery takings, were eight percent ahead of last year in the first 18 weeks of the current financial year to September 1, while retail space increased by 3.5 percent.
Speaking at the company's AGM, chairman Clive Clague said trading conditions continue to be extremely competitive, its decision to refocus its business was beginning to show results.
"Our overall progress continues to be in line with market expectations for the full year," Clague said.
